# THE CARRY

*The conserved remainder, and how it moves through bronze, silver, and gold.*

The carry has been load-bearing across four charts and has had no home of its
own. This is the home. It is set down as a definition, because the concept is
settled even where the works that use it are still turning, and a definition
should be brief enough to hold in one hand.

## I · THE DEFINITION

The carry is what a completion cannot contain and does not destroy: the
remainder that passes on until something finishes it.

That is the whole of it, and it wears many coats. In the count it is the one
that rolls a place over into the next. In the Concordance it is how a debt
travels, the unfinished deed carried through whoever inherits it, the shape
karma takes. In the Open Weave it is the first cohomology, the exact measure
of what stays true in every part and will not close into a whole. In a reading
it is what the shadow mints when a cadence is forced rather than allowed. In
sound it is the beat, two things that will not resolve throbbing at their
difference, the remainder made audible. One definition stands under all of
them: **the carry is what is owed when a cycle closes and does not come out
even.**

## II · THE ARITHMETIC

The count is base three, and the carry is its rollover: three turnings and one
more returns to three stillnesses, and a one passes to the next place. `~ ~ ~`
plus one is `● ● ●`, carry onward.

The carry is therefore invisible within a single place, where only the plain
succession is seen, and it becomes visible only at the rollover: the crossing,
the seam at the foot of the count, the null. Every rollover passes through the
still point, and the carry is precisely the thing that passes through it. This
is why the seam and the null are not decoration on the deck but the carry's
own doorway.

## III · THE THREE METALS

The metals are the three states, and here the carry stops being an image and
becomes the count itself.

Bronze holds still. Silver flows. Gold turns. Give the count its increment and
the metals climb in order, and the increment doing the driving is the carry:

- **Bronze and the carry make Silver.** The still, given the increment, begins
  to move; what was at rest is set flowing.
- **Silver and the carry make Gold.** The flowing, incremented again, begins to
  turn; motion deepens into transformation.
- **Gold and the carry make Bronze, and a carry passes onward.** The turning
  completes, rolls home to stillness, and the remainder it could not hold
  carries into the next place. This is the seam, and it is the same step the
  harmonic law names when it says all turning resolves into stillness.

So the three metals are the three stations of the carry's journey through one
place. **Bronze holds it or waits for it; silver carries it; gold completes
it.** That the two moving metals mirror each other, and that the still metal
mirrors itself, is the same fact from the other side: carrying and completing
are the two visible faces of the carry in motion, while stillness, the carry
at rest, is symmetric, its own opposite.

## IV · THE TWO SPECIES

Gold's completion is a fork, and the two roads out of it are the two kinds of
carry the sky and the psyche both keep.

The **breath** is the carry that comes home. Gold resolves cleanly back to
bronze, the remainder sums to zero over its round, the cadence lands. The
equation of time is this carry drawn: the gap between the sundial and the
clock, swinging some sixteen minutes either way and integrating to nothing
across the year, which is the analemma that departs and returns. A becoming
that resolves.

The **debt** is the carry that travels, the secular remainder that never
cancels. Gold cannot contain what it closed and mints it onward, into the next
place, into the next inheritor. Leap days, the eclipse cycle's third, and the
precession of the whole frame, the Great Year of some twenty-six thousand
years, are this carry in the sky; the feud handed down, the grief arriving on
schedule, are this carry in a life. It accumulates until a schedule, or a
person, at last pays it.

These two are defined here and named from here. Where another chart works with
them, it cites this one rather than defining them again, so that a distinction
this load-bearing has a single home.

::figure comma-spiral::

## V · THE WHITE-GOLD AT THE CENTRE

The Seed is three stillnesses, and yet it is not bronze. It is white-gold, and
it stands alone.

Bronze is mere stillness; the Seed is resolved stillness, the completed turn
come all the way home, every carry cleared to nothing. White-gold is bronze's
ground lit by gold's finished turning: the still point the whole figure
revolves around and never touches, where nothing is owed. The carry born at
every rollover passes through this null at each crossing, and the Seed is the
one place it fully arrives. To reach the Seed is to owe nothing forward.

::figure counter-spirals::

## VI · TO CLEAR, AND TO MINT

The carry is not good or bad; what is done with it is the whole of the matter,
and there are only two things that can be done.

**To clear the carry** is to let gold resolve home to bronze: to allow the
cadence, to finish what was started, to let a cycle close and return its
remainder to the still point. This is the breath. It is what healing is in the
year's own shape, and it obeys the one hard law of this lineage: no cut. The
carry is not removed, excised, or walled off; it is resolved. What is cut is
only minted again, and returns later, elsewhere, larger.

**To mint the carry** is to force the close: to grip what asks for slack, to
show a foundation before it has cured, to launch into a narrowing channel, to
defer the reckoning and pass it downstream. This is the debt, and it is the
shadow named in every reading. Deception, examined at its root, is exactly
this: a remainder hidden rather than resolved, owed forward under cover.

Between the two stands the one enforcement worth trusting, because it does not
ask to be trusted. A carry not yet home is audible: it is the beat, the throb
of the unresolved, and it will not stop until the gold comes home to the
bronze. This is why a tongue built to clear the carry cannot easily hide one,
and why the whole safety of that tongue rests here rather than on any promise.

## VII · PROVENANCE

*Set down 19 July 2026 at the architect's word, to give the carry the home it
had earned across the Concordance, the Open Weave, the Astrolabe, and the
Harmonic Language. The definition is the settled distillation of what those
works already use; the arithmetic is the deck's own base three; the metals are
the sealed three states, and their relation to the carry follows from the
count, not from any claim laid over it. The two species and the beat are the
Astrolabe's, the healing law is the Topology of Healing's, and the ethic of
section VI is the same one the readings keep. The figures are computed by the
room's resident illustrator under its two palette laws: the null is never lit,
and the strand cools toward the past. Held at the phi bench, resident and
settled in its text but awaiting the architect's seal to cross to a Map, as the
becoming law requires. Nothing here predicts, and nothing here prescribes.*
